notes: SUCCESS/CONTRACT: get_report_detail works end-to-end on preprod (project 379335744/PR-2005, report SC-489/id 10374). Bare call (no query) returns the full envelope with test_run_data populated but issues_data/test_run_status/test_cases_status/issues_by_status/issues_by_priority all null, exactly as guidance describes ('null means NOT COMPUTED'). is_print=true (the documented shortcut for Test Run Summary) computes every aggregate section in one call with real non-zero figures (test_run_status New:29/Under_Review:1, test_cases_status Untested:58/Passed:1, time_tracking cases_in_scope:119) — so report CONTENT is genuinely non-empty here, not just the config. VERIFIED: report config fields (data/project/identifier=SC-489) AND computed report_data content (via is_print) AND the *_drilldown row-paging path (sections=tr_drilldown&widget_type=active_runs, 30 rows returned). NOT EXERCISED: other widget_types, other report types (only Test Run Summary was available in the pool), report_data_only trap, and the specific_test_plans 422 case (report_timeframe here is last_one_week, not specific_test_plans). EMPTY-CASE RULE: distinguished cleanly — the report's own config (data/project) was never in question; what was actually empty on the BARE call was the unrequested report_data sections (null, by design per guidance) rather than an execution-driven emptiness, and once sections were requested (is_print) the figures came back real and non-trivial (this project has actual run/case activity, so it never hit a true zero-data case). PAGINATION: exercised both p=1 and p=2 for the tr_drilldown/active_runs section. total=30 exactly equals page_size=30 (one full page), so a genuinely empty second page could not be produced from this pool's data; p=2 returned byte-identical rows to p=1 with info.page still reporting 1 — inconclusive whether `p` is honored at all for this section or whether it silently clamps to the only available page; flagging as a possible defect worth a pool with >30 active runs to confirm. The info shape itself ({page, page_size} only, no count/prev/next/total_pages) is undeclared — get_report_detail's schema has no pagination envelope documented anywhere for report_data at all. GET_REPORT_DETAIL vs GET_REPORT_V2: this is a genuinely distinguished pair, not an unlabelled near-duplicate — three real differences, not one: (1) ID FORM — get_report_detail takes project_id/report_id as INTEGERS (the internal report id, obtainable only via list_schedules, not via list_reports_v2/get_report_v2 which only expose SC-NNN); get_report_v2 takes PR-NNN/SC-NNN strings directly off list_reports_v2. (2) ENVELOPE — get_report_detail returns {data, report_filters, filters, is_dynamic, dynamic_filters, report_data, project} including the resolved project record; get_report_v2 returns {success, data} with no project object. (3) CONFIG vs COMPUTED CONTENT — this is the decisive split: get_report_v2 is documented and observed as configuration-only, hard-coding dynamic_filters to null and never returning report_data/counts/rows under any parameters; get_report_detail is the only one of the two that computes and returns report_data (aggregates via sections/is_print, or paginated rows via *_drilldown+widget_type). A caller who has an SC-NNN and wants figures cannot get them from get_report_v2 at all — they must resolve the integer id (via list_schedules) and call get_report_detail. Both capabilities' own descriptions already state this distinction explicitly, so unlike other pairs flagged elsewhere in this index as unlabelled duplicates, this pair is correctly documented as non-duplicate.
